name: MineIT Desktop
description: The original MineIT game: a full 3D mining simulation on the standard ship scenario. Players walk and mine a generated surface, process substances, and operate from a crashed or landed expedition ship.
sharedLandUse: Generates a walkable 3D surface from the shared body-kind, world-type, atmosphere, landform, biome, hydrosphere and find-site vocabulary. Seeds, elevation, cell maps and deposit instances remain Desktop runtime and are not Universe canon.
sharedSubstanceUse: Consumes the Universe substance, part, machine and building catalogues. Desktop celestial-body generation is provenance for the land vocabulary, not a parallel planet list.
scenarioNotes: Default narrative frame is the Deep Reach / standard-ship restart. Named Universe worlds may be used as destinations; a generated crash-world map is per-save.
sourceSection: 10. How the three games use this language

name: MineIT Mobile
description: The mobile game: build and run a mining corporation across Commonwealth space. Landscapes display as a grid of squares on a named world.
sharedLandUse: Each landscape square names a landform (shape) and biome (cover), and may name hydrosphere, surface feature and find-site class. The grid is Mobile session state on a Directory world. Do not store a second canonical map in the mobile app.
sharedSubstanceUse: Buyers, substances, buildings and ships come from Universe. Collection logistics, contract prices and square ownership remain save state.
scenarioNotes: Operates in the Year-5326 commercial present. Worlds in the Directory are the same worlds shown on the map; generated-expansion worlds stay labelled as such.
sourceSection: 10. How the three games use this language

name: MineIT Single Mine
description: A small simulator in which the player operates one mine. The session is a single site, not a corporation map and not a full 3D world walk.
sharedLandUse: A play session is one site on a named world: one landform/biome context, optional hydrosphere and surface feature, and one find-site class. The site layout is session state. The site is not a new canonical world.
sharedSubstanceUse: Extracts Universe substance categories through the same find-site language. Stock, machine placement and depletion are save state.
scenarioNotes: May be set on any Directory world that has a kind and at least a landform/biome context. Prefer worlds with inferred or source-canonical surface assignment over kind-only moons.
sourceSection: 10. How the three games use this language
